scope: Native UI diagnostic restriction; does not claim a general Win98 USER.EXE or benchmark fix.
observation: Original2005 native03 accepts the official public Pro code. A foreign-thread BM_CLICK of its skinned registration confirmation is followed by a USER.EXE page fault at0008:0000185F before any3D draws. Relaunch retains Pro registration; actual keyboard input closes its Tip dialog, and the app exits and Win98 shuts down normally. Causality beyond this sequence is not established.
change: On Win9x, /click explicitly refuses BS_OWNERDRAW buttons before foregrounding or sending a click; use native keyboard/mouse input. Standard buttons, read-only enumeration/accessibility and XP behavior retain existing paths.
validation: Strict standalone MinGW no-CRT build, no extra link dependencies
